The Computer Science department is hosting an information session on graduate research opportunities next Tuesday at 5pm in the Eastman Building, room 204. Professor Hannah Liu will speak about her group's recent work on reinforcement learning for robotic manipulation, including a short demo of their latest sim-to-real transfer pipeline.

Refreshments will be provided, and current graduate students will stay afterwards to answer questions about applications, funding, and life in the program. Undergraduates from any year are welcome — there is no need to RSVP, but seating is limited so arriving a few minutes early is encouraged. Please email the department coordinator if you require accessibility accommodations.
